integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses only the exact formulas printed in the lead source, an elementary algebraic identity, a strict bound on the normalized surface-density parameter, and exact rational threshold arithmetic. The included checker only replays finite algebraic identities and is not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The constant 2625/19 is the exact threshold for Shen's specific projection-diameter certificate, not for the actual sign of the full Euclidean mean-distance difference. The claim does not exclude sharper direct estimates or smaller true counterexamples in the same family.
title: Sharp stretch threshold for the six-vertex mean-distance certificate
